start: First screen of app.mettleup.fit, no gym, online

steps.action: Under 'See it working' read the lines and tap 'Start demo'
user_sees: 'Opens a sample gym with made-up members, payments and a shop. …'
Today of a full sample gym under an orange strip 'Demo gym: made-up data. Nothing you do here is saved.' with 'Leave the demo'

steps.action: Add a member and take a payment in the demo
user_sees: They show in Members and Money like in a real gym
must_not: Any call to the gym server or another site
Anything written to the browser's storage except the dark or light choice
A WhatsApp or message sent to a real number

start: Prospect opens /demo?as=desk, or the demo without the shop while offline

user_sees: The sample gym as a front desk person sees it (no Expenses, no owner-only pages)
must_not: Owner pages open to the desk view

steps.action: On the first screen with no internet tap 'Open the demo without the shop. It works without internet.'
user_sees: The sample gym opens; shop parts say they need a real gym

steps.action: Open Settings > Branding, Members > Import, Help and feedback, Pay MettleUp
user_sees: 'This works in your own gym' and '<what the page does> The demo gym is made-up data kept only on this page, so this part is switched off here.' with 'Back to Today'
must_not: A form that looks real and fails on save
A real payment page for MettleUp

start: Prospect has changed things in the demo

user_sees: A new copy of the sample gym; the added member is gone; the strip still says nothing is saved
must_not: Dates in the sample gym left in the past (it is built from today)
Any other demo setting kept on the device

start: An owner signed in to a real gym on this browser opens /demo

steps.action: Open /demo and look around, then tap 'Back to my gym'
user_sees: Only made-up members in the demo
The strip button reads 'Back to my gym'
The real gym opens still signed in, unchanged
must_not: The real gym's members, session or saved copy readable inside the demo
A demo change written into the real gym
The owner signed out of the real gym
